headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds took down the Athletics 6-5, while the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6. The Milwaukee Brewers also secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Luinder Avila has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness for the Kansas City Royals. The Cincinnati Reds have also made changes to their injured list, transferring Blake Dunn to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow sprain and placing Hunter Greene on the 15-day injured list with right elbow soreness. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Arizona Diamondbacks, Los Angeles Angels, Toronto Blue Jays, and Washington Nationals.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.
